description: ✅ No API key needed. Fetch a benchmark's award-evidence pack after a verifiable award. Use it to recompute the root, digests, ranks and winners yourself. Arg: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark). Returns benchmark, test_set (with gold and salts, revealed only after the award), winners, rank_derivation, pack_hash, pack_anchor. Before the award it answers not_found naming the missing fact. Keyless and keyed calls get the same pack. REST twin: GET /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/award-evidence. Next: benchmark_commitment to compare the root.

inputSchema.description: A benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on its rail.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
